content.name: Hannah Osei
content.title: Senior Data Scientist
content.summary: Data scientist with nine years in insurance, rail ticketing and home retail, moving from pricing analysis into recommendation and forecasting models. At a Leeds homeware retailer I lead the personalisation workstream, where a rebuilt recommender added an estimated £2.4m in annual online revenue. Equally comfortable writing production Python and explaining uncertainty to a trading director.

experience.title: Senior Data Scientist
bullets: Lead the personalisation workstream with two data scientists and an ML engineer; our rebuilt product recommender lifted online revenue per session by 4.5%, worth about £2.4m a year.
Replaced a rules-based stock allocation tool with a probabilistic demand model for 9,000 SKUs, reducing store stockouts by 16% in the trial region.
Set up offline evaluation and A/B testing standards adopted by all four data teams in the business.
Run a monthly reading group and mentor two graduate analysts working towards data science roles.

experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Forecast daily passenger demand on 180 routes to support advance fare quotas, improving forecast accuracy by 22% against the legacy model.
Built a churn model for season ticket holders during the shift to hybrid working, helping the commercial team design flexible tickets that retained 11,000 customers.
Moved model training from desktop scripts to scheduled jobs on Azure Machine Learning, cutting retraining from two days to three hours.

experience.title: Data Analyst, Pricing
bullets: Maintained GLM-based risk models for home insurance with the actuarial team, refreshing factor tables each quarter.
Automated competitor price-scrape cleaning in Python, saving the pricing team around 12 hours a week.
Analysed renewal elasticity across 300,000 policies and supported the FCA pricing practices review with documented evidence.
